known_works.title: SciClaim-Bench: verifying novelty claims of AI-generated research ideas
known_works.abstract: We introduce SciClaim-Bench, a benchmark for verifying novelty claims of AI-generated research ideas against structured literature profiles. The benchmark covers claim extraction, closest-work retrieval and overlap labeling, but targets post-hoc claim audit rather than project-selection early warning.

known_works.title: CalibRank: lightweight contrastive calibration for small-sample literature ranking
known_works.abstract: CalibRank applies lightweight contrastive calibration to literature ranking under small-sample conditions, improving top-k stability with a declared weight rubric. Ablations show the calibration layer contributes most of the gain.

known_works.title: Citation graph echo patterns for reproducibility prediction
known_works.abstract: We predict reproducibility outcomes from citation graph echo structures after publication. Our method operates post-hoc on completed projects and does not provide any early-warning mechanism during project selection.

known_works.title: A survey of LLM-assisted research topic selection
known_works.abstract: This survey categorizes LLM-assisted topic selection pipelines into retrieval-augmented drafting and reviewer-style scoring. Committee-based multi-agent proposal generation is left to future work.

known_works.title: Feasibility estimation frameworks for empirical AI research
known_works.abstract: We provide a framework for estimating data, compute and personnel feasibility before experiments. Cross-lingual transfer scenarios are discussed only as an outlook and are not evaluated.
